title: Contextual producer authority successor on registered N37 stage
question: Can the exact contextual guard repair be authored and installed with the expected native delta?
method: Verify the generated guard in PostgreSQL, author a rollback-only candidate under the bound preview, register its generated artifacts, check offline parity and deploy from the exact N36 predecessor. Read stage and canonical revisions independently.
commands: uv run ci model change candidate 67b4e061a6cf451796ba03df4fd4be18 --json
uv run ci model change register 8281579fcb4643a9b51a85a5221b7f9a --json
uv run ci schema native-candidate --expected-predecessor semantic_ddo_pe_n37 --json
uv run ci model change deploy 8281579fcb4643a9b51a85a5221b7f9a --json
conclusion: The generated repair changed only the contextual input guard and its two descriptors. Registered N37 passed offline parity and deployed on the exact N36 stage. Canonical development remained N29.
